title: South Carolina AI Laws

reading.body:
South Carolina's only AI-related law is a proclamation designating March 30 through April 2, 2026 as AI Week and encouraging residents to learn about artificial intelligence.

The law passed on February 4, 2026, and imposes no obligations on developers, deployers, or infrastructure operators. No part of the text addresses compute, data centers, or electricity. Its only operative content is a date range and an encouragement, making it promotional rather than regulatory.

The record contains only this one law, so it cannot show whether other AI bills were introduced or failed. It also says nothing about local ordinances or pending legislation. The absence of substantive AI statutes in this list is a fact about enacted law, not a prediction about future policy.
